name: Ahipara
notes: Ahipara Superette: groceries and post shop. Cafe closes 2pm. First resupply after Cape Reinga.

name: Kaitaia
notes: Pak'nSave, Bells Produce, two bulk-food shops. 14 km inland from Ahipara; hitch or bus.

name: Mangamuka Bridge Dairy
notes: Dairy and takeaways on SH1, Mon-Fri 7am-6pm. Phone charging. Snacks only.

name: Kerikeri
notes: New World and Countdown. Full resupply, hostels.

name: Paihia
notes: Countdown Central plus a larger Countdown at Waitangi. Four Square on Williams Rd.

name: Opua
notes: Small general store, expensive. Ferry point.

name: Whananaki
notes: Whananaki Superette: limited supplies. Holiday park with a hut for TA walkers.

name: Matapouri
notes: Small general store.

name: Ngunguru
notes: Four Square dairy and takeaway, plus cafes. Limited and expensive.

name: Whangarei
notes: Countdown and Woolworths, hostels, buses. Inland from the Heads; a detour, not on route.

name: Ruakaka
notes: FreshChoice supermarket and takeaways.

name: Waipu
notes: Four Square, cafes, hotel with budget rooms. Camp Waipu Cove has a dairy.

name: Mangawhai Heads
notes: Four Square at 3 Wood St. Holiday park.

name: Mangawhai
notes: New World 1 km north of the village, plus a Four Square.

name: Warkworth
notes: Countdown, New World and a Bin Inn. About 6 km off trail.

name: Pakiri Beach Holiday Park
notes: Camp store: food, drinks, milk, bread. 9am-5pm summer only.

name: Puhoi
notes: General store 7am-7pm, historic pub, three cafes.

name: Orewa
notes: New World and Countdown, cafes, outdoor shops.

name: Silverdale
notes: Silverdale Centre: Woolworths, Macpac, Kathmandu, ATMs.

name: Browns Bay
notes: New World and Countdown.

name: Devonport
notes: New World. Ferry to the city.

name: Auckland CBD
notes: Full resupply and gear replacement. Metro supermarkets are smaller than suburban ones.

name: Mangere Bridge
notes: FreshChoice, slightly off trail.

name: Papakura
notes: Pak'nSave, Countdown, New World.

name: Mercer
notes: Service centre with food outlets; motel with camping.

name: Huntly
notes: Woolworths, about 1 km off trail.

name: Ngaruawahia
notes: New World and cafes.

name: Hamilton
notes: Pak'nSave, Woolworths, Trek N Travel outdoor store. Full gear replacement.

name: Whatawhata
notes: Petrol station store, gastro pub and village cafe.

name: Waitomo
notes: Waitomo Village Store 7am-7pm, expensive. Cafes and restaurants.

name: Te Kuiti
notes: New World and SuperValue.

name: Taumarunui
notes: New World at the west end. Seriously Outdoors for gear; canoe hire.

name: Owhango
notes: Blue Hill Cafe, 8am-2pm.

name: Whakapapa Village
notes: Camp store carries little more than ice blocks and muesli bars. Not a resupply.

name: National Park (Waimarino)
notes: Four Square, well stocked with dehydrated meals and gas. First real shop since Whanganui.

name: Whakahoro
notes: Blue Duck Cafe 8am-3pm Thu-Mon. DoC campsite. Blue Duck Station does meals and accommodation.

name: Pipiriki
notes: Minimal cafe and shop at the campground. Jetboat transfers.

name: Matahiwi
notes: Matahiwi Gallery and Cafe: coffee, cold drinks, local knowledge.

name: Whanganui
notes: New World, Countdown, Pak'nSave. Kathmandu; Wilsons Hunting and Outdoors stores bounce boxes.

name: Bulls
notes: Four Square at 114 Bridge St, plus takeaways.

name: Feilding
notes: New World, Bin Inn. Friday farmers market. 2-3 km off trail.

name: Palmerston North
notes: Pak'nSave, Woolworths, New World, Bin Inn. Full resupply.

name: Bunnythorpe
notes: Dairy, takeaway bar and toilets, on trail.

name: Levin
notes: Pak'nSave, New World, Countdown. About 9 km off trail.

name: Waikanae
notes: Countdown and New World near the town centre. No backpackers.

name: Paraparaumu Beach
notes: Cafes, shops and a small supermarket.

name: Paekakariki
notes: Dairy/grocery, two fruit and vegetable shops, cafes and a pub.

name: Porirua
notes: New World, Woolworths and Pak'nSave together, 150 m off trail.

name: Wellington
notes: Capital: full resupply, gear stores, bulk-food refilleries. End of the North Island.

name: Picton
notes: Four Square and FreshChoice on High St. Ferry arrival; off the walking route.

name: Havelock
notes: Small Four Square, post office, cafes. Havelock Holiday Park accepts food parcels.

name: Nelson
notes: Supermarkets, outdoor shops, backpackers. About 29 km off trail from Hacket car park.

name: St Arnaud
notes: General store and 24 hr NPD station; DoC centre sells gas and dehydrated meals. Alpine Lodge holds parcels ($15-30). Expensive.

name: Hanmer Springs
notes: Four Square, hot pools, backpackers. About 55 km off trail from Boyle; shuttle or hitch.

name: Boyle Village
notes: No shop. Boyle River Outdoor Education Centre holds resupply boxes, sells basic food, beds $50.

name: Arthur's Pass
notes: Arthur's Pass Cafe and Store: limited, expensive groceries. DoC centre sells gas. Mountain House holds boxes.

name: Lake Coleridge Village
notes: No shops. Powerhouse Lodge holds bounce boxes and has tent sites.

name: Methven
notes: Two supermarkets, Alpine Sports for dehydrated meals and gas. Snow Denn Lodge holds boxes ($5). Shuttle from Rakaia.

name: Geraldine
notes: Supermarket and accommodation. About 70 km from the Rangitata via Methven; community shuttle $24.

name: Peel Forest
notes: DoC Peel Forest camp and a small store. Homestay offers transport to the trailhead.

name: Mesopotamia Station
notes: Historic station near the Rangitata; holds food parcels.

name: Mt Potts Lodge
notes: Cafe and restaurant, closed Tue/Wed, book meals ahead. Has held food parcels; check first.

name: Lake Tekapo
notes: Large Four Square, cafes. Tailormade Backpackers and Bespoke Bikes receive bounce boxes.

name: Twizel
notes: Two Four Squares, Southern Alps Outdoors for gas. High Country Lodge holds parcels.

name: Lake Hawea
notes: Sailz general store with cafe, open to 9pm; FreshChoice on Bodkin St; Hawea Hotel for pub food.

name: Albert Town
notes: Small Four Square and a patisserie, a short detour off trail.

name: Wanaka
notes: New World, Four Square, Mediterranean Market for bulk, Macpac. Full resupply.

name: Arrowtown
notes: Small supermarket and a Night'n Day; limited and expensive. Hourly bus to Queenstown.

name: Frankton
notes: Pak'nSave, New World, Woolworths. Cheapest resupply in the Queenstown basin.

name: Queenstown
notes: FreshChoice, Four Square, outdoor stores. Full gear replacement.

name: Glenorchy
notes: Glenorchy Hotel general store. About 1.5 hr drive from the Greenstone car park.

name: Te Anau
notes: Four Square and FreshChoice, Outside Sports. 28-35 km off trail from SH94; shuttle or hitch.

name: Mossburn
notes: Four Square at 37 Devon St. About 20 km from the Princhester/SH94 junction.

name: The Key (Princhester)
notes: Sprig and Thistle coffee caravan at the SH94 junction, Tue-Fri 7am-3pm, Sat 8am-2pm.

name: Nightcaps
notes: Four Square and a pub. About 9-16 km east of the trail near Birchwood.

name: Otautau
notes: Small supermarket, hotels with backpacker beds. About 12-16 km east of Merrivale Rd.

name: Tuatapere
notes: Small supermarket, several lodges. About 26 km west of Merrivale Rd.

name: Colac Bay
notes: Colac Bay Bakehouse and Cafe with a camping ground; shop operating.

name: Riverton
notes: FreshChoice/SuperValue on Palmerston St, cafes and takeaways. Holiday park.

name: Otatara
notes: Four Square, on the way into Invercargill.

name: Invercargill
notes: Pak'nSave, New World, Woolworths, Macpac and Kathmandu. Last full resupply.

name: Bluff
notes: Four Square. Trail end at Stirling Point.
